messages:
sophie: Heads-up — Aventis Logistics flagged an expansion tonight. New teams: Ops + Field Agents. New use case: edge QA (on-device summarization & offline batch embeddings). They want a kickoff beginning of next month and called out ~10x QPS from current baseline.

raj: Can you drop the numbers they gave? sequence lengths, payload sizes, batch embed volumes, and whether they want private/Dedicated?

sophie: Pasted what they sent below (from their PM). They also asked about DLP/KMS for private deployment.

```json
{
  "customer": "Aventis Logistics",
  "requested_start": "2026-04-01",
  "peak_qps_estimate": "450",
  "avg_qps_estimate": "120",
  "seq_len_typical": "512",
  "batch_embeddings_per_day": "200000",
  "use_cases": ["on-device summarization", "daily batch embeddings for search"],
  "deployment_preference": "dedicated_or_private",
  "sla_needed": "latency < 200ms p95 for gen endpoints"
}
```

raj: OK. Main concerns: (1) memory pressure with 512 seq + KV cache for chat-like QA, (2) batching window for embeddings (we can amortize cost), (3) fallback plan if dedicated capacity not ready. For a dedicated pilot I'd recommend reserving 2x A100-ish hosts or a mix of 8xL4s depending on model quantization.

kevin: Thanks for the note. Renewal/expansion opportunity here — CS estimate: +$75k ARR if they convert this pilot into dedicated capacity. But risk: they said they'd consider a multi-region requirement (APAC) within 90 days which would add infra cost. If we promise dedicated throughput without a clear commit we might oversubscribe.

maria: Let's schedule an enablement + architecture working session. Proposed slots: Tue 10am or Thu 3pm next week. @raj @kevin can you join to run capacity + billing overview? I'll invite their infra and product folks.

raj: I can do Tue 10. Will prep a short runbook: what to measure in their telemetry, recommended model variants, and a quick perf checklist.

kevin: I'll join for billing + commercial terms. Suggest offering a 6-week dedicated pilot with optional extension and a performance review. If they sign within 30 days after pilot, we can offer a 10% commitment credit.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: #CS-4689 Reserving pilot capacity pool for Aventis Logistics (owner: infra-alloc). ETA for tentative reservation: 48h.

sophie: Great — I'll confirm Tue 10 and send the invite. Also asking them to share a small sample payload (300 requests) and a nightly embedding job manifest so we can run a dry perf test beforehand.

maria: Noted. I'll capture enablement slides and checklist in the playbook channel and coordinate success metrics for renewal: adoption of 3 teams + p50 latency under 150ms.

sophie: Quick callouts for the eng team: please advise on (A) a rough cost delta for APAC replication, (B) whether 8-bit quant + shard strategy meets the p95 < 200ms target for 512 sequences, and (C) any security blockers for KMS integration in Private.

raj: I'll run a short bench with quantized weights and a 512 seq profile tomorrow and post results here.

kevin: I'll draft a small term sheet for pilot pricing and send to legal for pre-approval.

sophie: Thanks all. Will update after the sample payload comes in — may be a quick win if the nightly batch embeddings can be shifted to off-peak and we keep gen traffic on dedicated endpoints. :rocket:

maria: +1, tracking as "expansion-high" in the account health dashboard.

sophie: (closing) I'll drop the invite and the customer's sample into this thread once I have them.
